title: The Quiet Safehouse
author: X. M. Blackwood
blurb: Mara Oyelaran, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
